configuration: Exact BOOLEAN wait_output per port; false default omitted; independent of receive wait/final
source: New cooperative scalar/aggregate/binary/bound-default WRITE; legacy direct state writes remain synchronous
capture: FILE, values and formats once; immutable bytes and one EOL transformation before waiting
admission: Complete payload fits beside retained RX within port/bank bounds before waiting; explicit host sleeper or scheduler for blocking; handler waits reject
progress: Ten-ms delays and checkpoints; explicit take_output drains; atomic append after original handle/root/registration/mapping/buffer/limit revalidation
cancellation: Exact pending token, portable status 6, no captured-byte append and normal continuation; cancellation wins over newly available space
lifetime: One pending typed operation per FILE; pause/resume retains bytes; stop/abort/budget/errors release only exact owned registrations; FILE lifetime remains explicit
persistence: Closed flags and RX/TX only; no pending payload/token/clock/frame/callback/generator reload
boundary: No physical serial transport, native timing/interrupt/status, partial writes, automatic RX reclamation, host isolation or strict equivalence
